name: Vernaccia di Oristano
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Sardinia wine around Oristano, Cabras and Santa Giusta, made only from Vernaccia di Oristano. It may be still wine or liqueur wine.
